title: A quasi-compact open of a base change X_A is defined over a finitely generated subalgebra
statement: Let $k$ be a field, let $X$ be a scheme over $k$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base] and let $A$ be a commutative $k$-algebra. For a $k$-subalgebra $A'\subseteq A$ write $X_{A'}=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}A'$ and $X_A=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}A$ for the base changes [def-pc-base-change], and $\pi:X_A\to X_{A'}$ for the morphism $\mathrm{id}_X\times\operatorname{Spec}(A'\hookrightarrow A)$ induced by the inclusion [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Let $V\subseteq X_A$ be a quasi-compact open subset. Then there are a $k$-subalgebra $A'\subseteq A$ that is finitely generated as a $k$-algebra and a quasi-compact open subset $V'\subseteq X_{A'}$ such that $V=\pi^{-1}(V')$. (No separatedness or quasi-separatedness of $X$ is assumed.)

proof.text: Choose finitely many affine opens $U_1,\ldots,U_n$ of $X$ whose base changes $U_{i,A}=U_i\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}A$, identified with the open subschemes $\mathrm{pr}_X^{-1}(U_i)$ of $X_A$ [lem-weil-pbc-open-fibre-product], cover $V$: affine opens form a basis of a scheme, and the resulting cover of the quasi-compact space $V$ has a finite subcover. Write $U_i=\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)$.

source.place: Varieties, proof of Lemma Tag 0388, lines 819--821

proof.text: For each $i$, the principal opens in the affine scheme $U_{i,A}\cong\operatorname{Spec}(R_i\otimes_k A)$ [lem-weil-pbc-fibre-product-affine-spectra] form a basis. Applying this basis to the open $V$ and using quasi-compactness of $V$, choose finitely many elements $f_{ij}\in R_i\otimes_k A$ such that $V=\bigcup_{i,j}D(f_{ij})\subseteq\bigcup_iU_{i,A}$. This does not assert that $V\cap U_{i,A}$ is quasi-compact; it only uses a finite subcover of the basis of $V$.

source.place: Varieties, proof of Lemma Tag 0388, lines 821--829

proof.text: Each of the finitely many tensors $f_{ij}$ involves only finitely many coefficients of $A$. Let $A'\subseteq A$ be the $k$-subalgebra generated by all those coefficients. Then $A'$ is finitely generated over $k$, and every $f_{ij}$ is the image of an element $f'_{ij}\in R_i\otimes_k A'$. Define $V'=\bigcup_{i,j}D(f'_{ij})\subseteq X_{A'}$. It is a quasi-compact open because it is a finite union of affine principal opens.

source.place: Varieties, proof of Lemma Tag 0388, lines 829--838

proof.text: Let $\pi:X_A\to X_{A'}$ be induced by $A'\hookrightarrow A$. Under the identifications of steps 1 and 2 (for $A$ and for $A'$) [lem-weil-pbc-open-fibre-product] [lem-weil-pbc-fibre-product-affine-spectra], $\pi^{-1}(U_{i,A'})=U_{i,A}$ and $\pi|_{U_{i,A}}$ is $\operatorname{Spec}$ of $R_i\otimes_kA'\to R_i\otimes_kA$, so base change carries each $D(f_{ij})$ into $D(f'_{ij})$, so $V\subseteq\pi^{-1}(V')$. Conversely, if $x\in X_A$ has $\pi(x)\in V'$, then $\pi(x)\in D(f'_{ij})$ for some $i,j$; the image of $f'_{ij}$ is $f_{ij}$, hence $x\in D(f_{ij})\subseteq V$. Thus $V=\pi^{-1}(V')$.

split_report.summary: Read Stacks Varieties Lemma Tag 0388 and split its proof into four steps: finite affine neighborhoods of the quasi-compact open, a finite principal-open presentation, descent of the finitely many coefficients to a finitely generated k-subalgebra, and equality after pullback. No new node was needed: the auxiliary facts are the affine-open basis, finite subcovers of a quasi-compact space, finite coefficient support in a tensor, and the definition of principal opens.
